newsitem.title: ITALY: IBM Semea sees lower 1996 profit and sales.
newsitem.headline: IBM Semea sees lower 1996 profit and sales.

text.p: IBM Semea should see 1996 net profit of "several tens of billions of lire but slightly down on 1995" with turnover of 9.48 trillion lire against 10.40 trillion in 1995, IBM Semea managing director Tomaso Quattrin said.
IBM Semea is the U.S. computer giant's Southern Europe, Middle East and Africa division.
Net profit in 1995 was 171 billion lire.
Quattrin, outlining preliminary 1996 results after a board meeting, said turnover was down in all the component sectors and exports were hit by a world fall in computer memory prices.
PC sales for the division totalled 140,000 but here too turnover was down "because we decided not to participate in a price war," he said.
